plugins.name: ClinePassBridge
plugins.description: 将 Cline Pass 接入 CPA，支持多凭据管理、模型映射与上游选择、统一错误规则、额度耗尽自动暂停、流式与非流式调用及请求日志。实验性通用代理池默认关闭，支持标准 HTTP / HTTPS / SOCKS5 代理。 / Connect Cline Pass to CPA with multi-credential management, model mapping and provider selection, shared error rules, automatic quota pause, streaming and non-streaming requests, and request logs. The experimental general-purpose proxy pool is off by default and supports standard HTTP / HTTPS / SOCKS5 proxies.
plugins.author: xiao-qiu-qiu
